info.title: nuget-check - NuGet vulnerability auditor
info.description: Audits .NET NuGet dependencies (packages.config / packages.lock.json) for known vulnerabilities via the GitHub Advisory Database, similar to npm audit.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: summary, table, json (default: summary)

options.name: --severity
options.description: Filter by severity: critical, high, moderate, low

options.name: --config
options.description:
Path to a .dependably-check config file. When omitted, the
file is discovered by walking up from the current directory.

options.name: --rest
options.description: Use the GitHub REST API instead of GraphQL (github source)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
Policy checks:
In addition to vulnerabilities, nuget-check flags any configured NuGet package
source whose host is not public (api.nuget.org / nuget.org) and not allowlisted
in .dependably-check (common.allowedRegistryHosts ∪ nuget.allowedRegistryHosts).
An untrusted source is an error and exits non-zero.
Environment Variables:
GITHUB_TOKEN               GitHub personal access token (required for the github source)
